interpretation.brief: I want a five-inch FieldDeck cyberdeck for field notes. I need three hours of working battery time. Use 1.35 amps for the Raspberry Pi's work load. Estimate whether it can meet that target.
interpretation.explanation: Build the Fielddeck 5 using its existing Raspberry Pi 4, modeled Anker A1259 battery, and existing five-inch display. The runtime study estimates battery life with the Pi work load set to 1.35 A and checks it against the three-hour target; the target may be unmet, which remains a valid simulation result.
